# KeyForge

> KeyForge (keyforge.win) is a Roblox and Luau script authentication, access-management, and protection platform.

Official site: https://www.keyforge.win
This GitHub repository is integration examples, a local Luau minify/format CLI, and docs. It does not contain KeyForge source or the hosted wYnFuscate engine.

KeyForge is not the fantasy card game that also uses the name KeyForge.

## Integrate

- Default loader: `_G.script_key` + HttpGet https://www.keyforge.win/v1/load/{projectId}
- SDK (do not vendor): https://www.keyforge.win/sdk/client.lua
- Methods: getKeyUrl, verify, loadScript
- Result codes: KEY_VALID, KEY_INVALID, KEY_EXPIRED, KEY_REVOKED, HWID_MISMATCH, RATE_LIMITED, NETWORK_ERROR
